description: This file defines a templated C++ class 'WSEndpoint' within the 'WebSockets' namespace. The class manages WebSocket server endpoints, including connection handling, message sending, and event loop control, utilizing various template parameters for role, messaging, ping-pong, and encryption functionalities.

classes.name: WSEndpoint
classes.description: A templated class managing WebSocket server endpoints with role, messaging, ping-pong, and encryption capabilities.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the WebSocket connection.

methods.name: startEventLoop
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket event loop in a separate thread.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the connection pointer associated with a given connection handler.

methods.name: registerHandlers
methods.description: Registers WebSocket event handlers such as onMessage, onOpen, onFail, onClose.
